title: DaoFic
tagline: DaoFic allows Everyone to Build Super Communities with SuperFluid Payments
description: DaoFic is a purpose built Dapp for DAOs to manage community payments. It is built with SuperFluid Smart Contracts and SDKs. DaoFic provides users to make payments in USDC to end users with their wallet/account addresses. It provides a Dashoard with various stats on Total Payment Streams, Active Payment Streams and Total Users. It also provides a detailed list of all transfers made. video: https://vimeo.com/697912151/188703777c
how_its_made: DaoFic is a purpose built Dapp for DAOs to manage community payments. It is built with SuperFluid Smart Contracts and SDKs. DaoFic provides users to make payments in USDC to end users with their wallet/account addresses.  Front is built with reactjs and other open source libraries.
